### ✨ OUTERPLANE Mod Menu (v1.4.22)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **OUTERPLANE** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode & 0 Cooldown (Player Only)** — Auto-Unlinked: Player heroes take 0 damage, max ShieldHP & 0s cooldown
- **One-Hit Kill Enemies** — Deals instant 999,999 damage to enemy targets in CCharacterBattle.AddHP
- **Damage & Reward Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Scales CCharacterBattle.GetAttackStat, CalcDamageDOT & UpdateExpGauge
- **Bypass Battle Damage Cap** — Scales CBattleManager.ApplyDamageCap so high damage is never capped
- **Auto-Unlinked Team Detection** — Uses CCharacterBattle team & player link so enemies never gain buffs

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
